author: K22 (Commons user Kevin Rodriguez 22)
attribution: K22, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Older (2022) three-quarter face, smiling, studio-like light. Shows the nose bridge, the left ear and the beard shape. He looks younger and leaner-faced here than in 2026, so use it only as a cross-check.

author: Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Primavera, U.S. Army (DVIDS 9747962, VIRIN 260613-A-BN614-2853)
license: Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government; Commons tags it PD with the ID-USMil template)
attribution: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Primavera, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Added in review. Local file is a crop (340x490 px from the 1920 px thumbnail) that keeps only Gaethje; the full frame also shows a child and an honor cordon. Lincoln Memorial steps at night, black suit and white shirt, looking down, three-quarter view of his RIGHT side. Good for the haircut (skin fade on the sides, longer top styled back with product), the right ear and the beard line along the jaw. Top-down night light: do not sample skin from it. The same image is also on Commons from Flickr as 'UFC Freedom 250 Press Conference at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington on June 12, 2026 - 38.jpg' (same photographer and caption).

author: UFC / ESPN official athlete portrait (photographer not credited)
date_taken: undated; ESPN CDN Last-Modified is 2026-06-11 and he holds a UFC belt, so it was shot after his January 2026 interim-title win
notes: Best frontal face: even studio light, shirtless, cut-out background. Main source for face proportions, eyes, brows, nose width and beard shape. High-key light washes the skin out a little.

author: UFC / ESPN official athlete portrait (photographer not credited)
date_taken: undated; ESPN CDN Last-Modified for the original file is 2025-03-07, so it was shot in early 2025 or before (not a 2026 photo)
notes: Full body, head to toe, in fight shorts and gloves, studio light, slight three-quarter turn. Best physique and tattoo reference (cross on the right upper arm, 'BEFORE / DISHONOR' warrior piece on the right side, small black line-work curl on the left side of the ribcage). The white diagonal stripes, the vertical UFC wordmark and the crypto.com logo are all on his RIGHT leg (viewer's left).

author: Jeff Bottari / UFC / Getty Images
notes: Lincoln Memorial face-off. Gaethje (right, black suit) in a near-left profile, smiling. Shows the haircut (short faded sides, longer top), the left ear and the back of the head. A microphone partly covers the nose.

author: Jeff Bottari / UFC / Getty Images
notes: UFC 324, belt being fastened after the Pimblett win. Shows fight shorts (black, Monster Energy and crypto.com logos), red-cuffed gloves, arms and torso straight after a five-round fight.

author: Getty Images (via theScore; photographer not named on the image)
notes: On top of the cage after UFC 324. Close three-quarter face from above, left side. Good for the nose shape (broad, flattened bridge, rounded tip; fresh cut on the bridge), eye colour, left ear (small cut on the rim) and hair texture when sweaty. Also the only photo showing part of a small black outline tattoo on the back of his left shoulder, and a side view of the left-rib tattoo (an eye-like curl).
